The '''Second Division''' was one of two [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Division/Legends|divisions]] that made up the [[Unidentified Centax-1 garrison|garrison]] of some twenty thousand [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] stationed on [[Centax-1/Legends|Centax-1]]. The division was placed under the leadership of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the [[Battle of Praesitlyn|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Praesitlyn/Legends|Praesitlyn]].<ref name="JT" />
